meta.title: HAZOP and LOPA of the C-101 unit
meta.scope: From the gas packs and the ethanol tank to the cold vent and the product tank T-601, including utilities (instrument air, N₂, chilled water, electrical power).
meta.objective: Identify the hazards and operability problems of the unit, judge their risk, and decide what must be added or changed. For the scenarios that need more than the existing safeguards, check the risk reduction by LOPA.
meta.assump: The unit is operated by trained staff at the design conditions. Nitrogen, instrument air and power are available at start-up. Instruments and relief valves are tested on the plan in the maintenance procedure.
meta.protocol: Method: HAZOP to IEC 61882 with full recording. The team takes one node at a time, states its design intent, and applies the guide words to each parameter to find deviations. For each deviation it records the causes, the events that follow, the consequences without credit for safeguards, the existing safeguards, and the risk after safeguards (S × L). Rows above the tolerable level go to LOPA in the same worksheet: initiating-event frequency, enabling conditions and conditional modifiers, independent protection layers with their PFD, and the mitigated frequency compared with the tolerable event likelihood for the severity. Open points go to the Parking Lot; actions become recommendations with an owner and a due date.

N4.causes:
P-108 trips (motor, power)
HV-105 closed by mistake
loop isolation valve shut
N4.cons: Vapour no longer condensed: ester vapour to VP-101 and the vent, top pressure rises; no reflux

N4.causes:
HV-105 strainer blocking (flow down by up to 80 %)
HIC-105 set too low
P-108 worn
N4.cons: Condenser capacity falls; part of the vapour passes to VP-101; FSLL-108 trips heating when the flow falls below its setting

N4.causes:
Tempered-water TCV fails (supply falls to ≈ 22 °C)
loop heater off
cold water used at start-up
N4.cons: C16/C18 esters freeze on the tubes: E-103 plugs, condenser capacity and vacuum lost, column upset, ester to VP-101

N4.causes: Loop heater or TCV fails towards heating
N4.cons: Less temperature difference: condenser capacity falls a little (dew point ≈ 190 °C); small effect

N4.dev: Water enters the process side (E-103 tube leak)
N4.causes:
Tube leak
process side is under vacuum so water leaks inward
N4.cons: Water flashes in E-103/D-104: pressure rises, P-104 cavitates, wet product

N4.dev: Frozen ester left in E-103 from the last batch
N4.causes:
Tempered water left running cold after shutdown
cold start with water below 45 °C
N4.cons: Next start-up with a partly plugged condenser: high pressure, vapour to VP-101

N4.dev: Vapour load above the condenser capacity
N4.causes:
Duty much higher than design (N2/N3)
condenser capacity margin 2.5× the design load (assumed)
N4.cons: Uncondensed vapour to VP-101, pressure rises

sg.text: FSLL-108 trips heating at < 0.36 m³/h (10 s, shares FT-108 with FI-108)
E-103 OVLD alarm (condenser overloaded) on the DCS

recs.text: Fit a non-return and an automatic isolation valve on the VP-101 suction; add a VP-101 run-status alarm.
Route the VP-101 exhaust outdoors through a demister; check and empty the trap every batch; consider a cold trap.
Clamp the JIC-101 set point at 5 kW once the pot boils and add a PDI-103 high-high override in the BPCS that cuts duty; train the heat-up duty cut.
Analyse every charge before charging (water, methanol, C16:0) and adapt the cut plan to the feed.
Add a TI-109 low-low alarm and make the tempered-water TCV fail towards warm; consider stopping heating when TI-109 stays below 40 °C (assumed).
Fit a duplex strainer with a ΔP gauge upstream of HV-105.
Warm E-103 to 60 °C before the first vapour arrives and never leave the tempered water cold after shutdown.
Carry every High row and every row that relies on a SIS-100 trip into LOPA; record the SIL targets in the SRS.
Train the deviations of the dynamic check on the simulator (one per shift team) and revalidate this HAZOP every 5 years or at any MOC.

safe: PIC-102 L alarm at 140 mbar (Column top pressure, suppressed while VP-101 is stopped)
PIC-102 H alarm at 200 mbar (Column top pressure, suppressed while VP-101 is stopped)
PDI-103 H alarm at 18 mbar (Column ΔP high (flooding), active only while boiling in RUN)
TIC-101 H alarm at 280 °C (Pot temperature high)
TIC-107 H alarm at 315 °C (Hot-oil supply high)
JIC-101 H alarm at 5 kW (Pot duty high (flooding risk), active only while boiling in RUN)
LIC-104 L alarm at 20 % (Reflux drum level, suppressed while P-104 is stopped)
LIC-104 H alarm at 85 % (Reflux drum level, suppressed while P-104 is stopped)
LI-101 L alarm at 30 % (Pot level low, active in RUN only)
FI-108 L alarm at 0.6 m³/h (Tempered-water flow low, suppressed outside RUN with P-108 stopped)
TI-109 L alarm at 45 °C (Tempered-water temperature, suppressed outside RUN with P-108 stopped)
TI-109 H alarm at 80 °C (Tempered-water temperature, suppressed outside RUN with P-108 stopped)
TI-105 L alarm at 45 °C (Condensate cold (freezing risk), active only while boiling in RUN)
FIC-104 L alarm at 20 kg/h (Reflux flow low, suppressed while P-104 is stopped)
C-101 AIR alarm (air entering the hot column)
E-103 OVLD alarm (condenser overloaded, vapour to the vacuum pump)
P-104 DRY alarm (reflux pump running dry)
TSHH-101 (TE-101B, own sensor) pot > 290 °C – SIS-100 trip SIF-01, 5 s delay
PSHH-102 (PT-102, shared with PIC-102) top > 300 mbar – SIS-100 trip SIF-02, 5 s delay, armed in RUN
FSLL-108 (FT-108, shared with FI-108) tempered water < 0.36 m³/h – SIS-100 trip SIF-03, 10 s delay, armed in RUN
LSLL-101 (LT-101, shared with LI-101) pot level < 20 % – SIS-100 trip SIF-04, 5 s delay, armed in RUN
TSHH-107 (TE-107B, own sensor) hot oil > 330 °C – SIS-100 trip SIF-05, 5 s delay
HS-100 emergency stop button (manual SIS-100 trip)
SIS-100 trip action: TV-101 shut (JIC-101 MAN 0 %), HE-101 off (TIC-107 MAN 0 %), XV-101 closed, XV-107 to total reflux
LSLL-104 D-104 level < 5 % stops P-104 (pump protection, 5 s; equipment interlock, not a SIF)

SIS-100 arming permissives: VP-101 running and PIC-102 below 250 mbar; Tempered water P-108 running, FI-108 ≥ 0.6 m³/h; Pot level LI-101 above 30 %; Hot-oil pump P-101 running; Hot oil TIC-107 below 320 °C; N₂ vacuum break HV-110 closed
PV-102 fail open (PIC-102)
TV-101 fail closed (JIC-101)
FV-104 fail open (FIC-104)
FV-105 fail closed (FIC-105)
XV-101 SIS valve fail closed
HE-101 heater runs only with P-101 running (as the model behaves; to be confirmed on the plant)
HV-110 N₂ vacuum break only with the pot below 150 °C (procedure)
Leak test (pressure-rise test, VP-101 isolated) before heat-up
D-105 sample and lab result before each cut switch
End-of-campaign rule (cumulative TK-202 purity)
Charging procedure 110 L (LI-101)
Residue drained below 60 °C (SOP-11)
VP-101 trap (collects uncondensed ester)
Operator response to the alarm
Written procedure (SOP) and checklist
Insulation of hot surfaces and PPE for sampling and draining
Fire extinguishers and emergency response
